thesis: The combination of a 305.3x trailing P/E, 150.0x forward P/E, 4.0% net margin, and price below all major moving averages outweighs positive free cash flow and mixed analyst support.
strongest_counterexample: An oversold RSI, positive MACD histogram, and materially lower forward P/E could signal that the current weakness is temporary rather than structural.
invalidation_conditions: Sustained improvement in revenue, margin, and free cash flow
Price recovery above the 50- and 200-day moving averages
Evidence that future earnings can justify the current valuation
evidence_gaps: No breakdown of forward earnings assumptions
decisive_factors: Price below all three major moving averages
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
